title: Claims Schedule: Crossover Arrangements, Filing and Payment Windows, and the Providers Each Letter Pays For
content:
Claims on Medicare Supplement Insurance Policies reach the supplement from Medicare, and each policy carries the window within which a claim must reach the supplement after Medicare's determination, the window within which the supplement must pay a clean crossover claim, and the providers the policy pays for.

| Policy | Claims sent by Medicare automatically | Filing window after Medicare's determination, calendar days | Payment window for a clean crossover claim, calendar days | Providers the policy pays for |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan A | yes | 365 | 30 | any provider in the United States who accepts Medicare |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan B | yes | 365 | 30 | any provider in the United States who accepts Medicare |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan D | yes | 365 | 30 | any provider in the United States who accepts Medicare |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan K | yes | 365 | 30 | any provider in the United States who accepts Medicare |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan N | yes | 365 | 30 | any provider in the United States who accepts Medicare |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan G | yes | 365 | 21 | any provider in the United States who accepts Medicare, including providers who do not accept assignment |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement High Deductible Plan G | yes | 365 | 21 | any provider in the United States who accepts Medicare, including providers who do not accept assignment |

### Boundary illustration on the filing window

Take, as a hypothetical, a Medicare determination made on a claim under Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan D. The filing window is 365 calendar days after that determination, so a claim reaching the supplement on the 365th day is inside the window and one reaching it on the 366th day is outside it. The same window of 365 calendar days stands on every letter in the product.

### Notes

Medicare sends claims to the supplement automatically on every letter in the product.

The payment window for a clean crossover claim is 30 calendar days on Plan A, Plan B, Plan D, Plan K and Plan N, and 21 calendar days on Plan G and High Deductible Plan G.

The providers the policy pays for are any provider in the United States who accepts Medicare; on Plan G and High Deductible Plan G that basis extends to providers who do not accept assignment.
